description: #35 d29, #39: moves the fixer queues with the built-in queue.progress. Frees the slot of a dispatched pr-fix run that ended, drops a request whose PR closed or whose head moved, and, while fewer pr-fix runs are dispatched than a queue's pool cap, dispatches its oldest request as a rules.queue.dispatch event that pr-fixer-dispatch turns into the pr-fix run. With vars.fixer_levels every level's queue moves on its own pool (pr-fixer on qwen-spark2, pr-fixer-codex on codex-spark), the try's level is resolved at dispatch (the PR's counted attempts plus one), an unavailable level is skipped as vars.fixer_unavailable says, and the dispatch event names the level, fixer, reviewer and attempt; with no level left the story is handed back once. Answers every waiting request's place in line. Non-agentic.
name: Progress the fixer queue

steps.description: The built-in queue.progress on queues/pr-fixer and, with vars.fixer_levels, every level's queue. Reads each PR it is about to dispatch as the App (state and head); a failed read dispatches anyway, the run's own head guard stops a stale one.
steps.name: Progress the queue
